query_results.query_text: My handset took a dip in the toilet — will my protection plan cover the repair?
query_results.final_answer: Yes, your protection plan covers accidental liquid immersion, such as a drop in the toilet, provided the damage was not intentional. Please do not attempt to charge the device, keep it in a dry environment, and file your claim within 48 hours.

query_results.query_text: We're moving our company to a new telecom provider and need to keep our existing contact numbers.
query_results.final_answer: To keep your existing business phone numbers, you must submit a Port Authorization Code (PAC) or account transfer PIN from your current carrier for each number through the 'Number Management' section of the admin portal. Porting typically takes 5–7 business days, or up to 10 business days for toll-free numbers, and you should ensure your previous contract allows for this without early termination fees.

query_results.query_text: How do I add insurance to devices on my account?
query_results.final_answer: To add insurance, log in to your admin portal and navigate to the "Insurance & Protection" section to enroll your devices. Alternatively, you can visit a retail location to speak with a representative. SMB account holders may also enroll multiple devices in bulk through the admin portal.

query_results.query_text: What happens when I switch to a different plan mid-month?
query_results.final_answer: Plan changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle. Please contact your account manager to model cost scenarios before committing to a change.

Deductible amounts depend on your plan tier (Basic, Enhanced, or Total Coverage) and device type, ranging from $0 to $99 per approved claim. Payments are due at the time of claim approval via credit card or account credit.

query_results.query_text: And how long does that usually take?
query_results.final_answer: Shipping for a device swap typically takes 3–5 business days via standard delivery or 1–2 days with expedited shipping. query_results.query_text: I want to file a claim for my broken screen.
query_results.final_answer: To file a claim for your broken screen, log in to your account at my.carrier.com, navigate to 'Insurance & Protection', and select 'File a Claim', or call 1-800-555-0147. You must have your device's IMEI number, the date of the incident, and a brief description of the damage ready. Please ensure your claim is submitted within 60 days of the damage occurring.

query_results.query_text: How do I give one of my employees access to manage the company's phone account?
query_results.final_answer: To grant an employee access to manage the account, the primary account holder must log into the admin portal and create a sub-administrator account under 'User Management > Admin Accounts'. You can use role-based access control (RBAC) to assign specific, limited permissions to these sub-admins.
